name: CounterCtrl Cloud
description: CounterCtrl Cloud reads overnight POS transaction data and grades every location, category and item against thresholds you set. Five modules: Sales, Loss Prevention, Orders, Weekly Performance and Coupons.
featureList: Nightly sales, margin and item movement reporting
Loss prevention exception reporting ranked by exposure
Role-scoped access from store floor to C-suite
Mobile reporting for store and department managers

audience.audienceType: Grocery and retail operators, from single-location owners to corporate banners

_comment_offers: Add an Offer block only if pricing is public. Omitting it is fine; a fake price is not.
_comment_rating: Do NOT add aggregateRating without real, verifiable reviews. Google issues manual actions for fabricated review markup.
